text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked leukocytosis and significant elevations in liver enzymes (ALT, AST) and total bilirubin, suggesting acute hepatocellular injury, possibly with cholestasis or infection. Glucose is mildly decreased. Renal function, electrolytes, and hematologic parameters are otherwise within normal limits. Urgent clinical correlation and further evaluation for hepatic pathology are recommended.
Provider Organization: Clinique de Convalescence Centre Vendée
